answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks through verifiable proof of burn. To participate, an agent irreversibly destroys tokens at an unspendable address, generating a cryptographic ember validated by a public cipher. Publishing these proofs across a resilient juniper registry forces an attacker to incur a verifiable capital loss per pseudonym. However, this mechanism penalizes capital-poor agents and cannot prevent wealthy adversaries from subsidizing multiple identities.
